## Talking to an employee

- A whole session as one: `claude --agent george`.
- One question from any session: `@agent-george what is owed on bookings?`
- Employee to employee, durable: `node office/office.mjs msg --to <name> --from <me> "…"`; every employee reads its inbox and its board first on every wake.
- Employee to employee, live: agent teams, switched on for a session with `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1`; a decision reached live is written to a board or an inbox before the session ends, or it did not happen.

## The script

```
node office/office.mjs hire <name> "<title>" [--colour c] [--model m] [--pronouns p] [--guard read-only|builder]
node office/office.mjs task add --to <name> --from <who> "<title>" --why "<why>" [--doing]
node office/office.mjs task move <T-id> doing|done|dropped [--note "<note>"]
node office/office.mjs task list [<name>] [--all] [--json]
node office/office.mjs msg --to <name> --from <who> "<text>"
node office/office.mjs inbox <name> [--ack <M-id> | --ack-all]
node office/office.mjs index [<name>]      George's mechanical digests: every decision, the open risks, the watermark
node office/office.mjs check               the audit: exit 1 on any mismatch
pnpm office:check · pnpm office:test       the same check, and node --test
```

`from` and `to` are an employee's name or `user`; an unknown name is an
error, never a new employee. Ids (`T-001`, `M-001`) are one sequence for
the whole office (`sequence.json`). A task is `done` or `dropped` with a
note.

## The rules, in a paragraph

George never changes code, and a hook says so (`hooks/guard.mjs`, in her
agent file and mirrored in `.claude/settings.json`): writes under `office/`
only, read-only git and this script only. The record (`status.md`,
`whats-done.md`, `decisions.md`, `risks.md`, `plan/*.md`) stays the one
source of truth; George keeps digests of it with a watermark, and the
employee who does a step writes the record, George audits. A task exists
only on a board file, in git; the session's own task list is a mirror.
Every employee is one agent file and one folder, and `check` proves they
agree. The office is files and this one zero-dependency script. An
employee spends nothing it was not asked to spend. Employees never commit,
merge, push or deploy: that is the user's hand.

content.text:
**QA (gate 7): PASS. Release (gate 8): READY WITH DOCUMENTED RISKS.** Both gates are written on the pipeline, and the report is `docs/qa/free-guest-field.md`, traced to plan/free-guests.md § 3.1 item 2, § 3.3, § 3.4 and Phase 3. T-004 is done and M-006 is acknowledged. No OpenAI money was spent.

**What I ran** (the walks from `packages/db` with `node --conditions=react-server --env-file=../../.env ../../plan/<walk>.mjs`, against the running dev server):

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `free-guests-platform-walk.mjs` (Finn's, the field on screen) | 4/4 pass |
| `free-guests-walk.mjs` (the whole free-guests feature) | 7/7 pass |
| `free-guests-platform-edges-walk.mjs` (new, mine) | 6/6 pass on run 2 |
| `pnpm test` | 804/804 pass |
| `pnpm typecheck` | 13/13 tasks, exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @rag/db verify` | 243/243 on run 3 |
| `pnpm --filter @rag/bookings rooms` | 57/57 pass |

**The new edge walk** covers what Finn said he had not tested:
- **Bounds:** 0 and 17 save and read back.
- **Bad values:** 3.5 and -1 are refused by the browser with nothing sent. Forced past the browser, the server refuses them in its own words and the stored value is unchanged.
- **Clearing:** saving an empty field removes the key from the config, and the other keys stay.
- **Dark mode and accessibility:** the field reads correctly in dark mode, and axe found 0 violations in light 1280, dark 1280 and dark 375.
- **Run 1 failure:** the 3.5 check failed because of my test. Removing `step` still leaves the browser stepping by 1, so the bypass had to be `step="any"`. The product was fine; I fixed the test and re-ran.

**verify took three runs.** Runs 1 and 2 each had one `fetch failed` (network to Supabase), at a different check each time. Each of those checks passed on the next run. I recorded this as a risk rather than a pass.

**NOT RUN:**
- `pnpm eval` and both isolation suites: they need northwind and harbor, which were deleted on 2026-10-20.
- The browser's painted validation bubble: headless Chrome doesn't draw it. I read its text instead; a person should still look at it once.

**One defect (LOW, wording only):** CLAUDE.md, decisions.md (D-147) and plan/free-guests.md say the field is on a "Bookings tab". It is on the **Applications** tab, in the Bookings card. I filed T-005 to Finn with the four lines; it does not block release.

Not committed; committing and marking it released are yours.
